steps.output_raw:

User only wants checking, which isn’t in list. I should give concise, actionable steps to link an account: verify login, account ownership, then in-app steps and when to call support. Keep it short. </think>
<plan>

2. Provide step-by-step instructions to try linking it in online/mobile banking.

<action type="say">
Here’s how you typically get a missing checking account linked to your online profile:

1) Confirm you’re using the right login  
- If you’ve ever had multiple usernames (old personal vs. joint vs. business), the checking might be tied to another one.  
- Log out and check if you have another username you’ve used with this bank. If yes, try signing in with that and see if the checking appears there.

2) Make sure the checking is eligible and in your name  
- The account usually must list you as an owner or authorized signer to show up.  
- If it’s a joint account or recently opened, it may take a day or two to appear, or may need a manual link by support.

3) Use the “Link/Show all accounts” option (if available)  
In most online/mobile banking apps, look for something like:  
- “Link an existing account”  
- “Add account / Show hidden accounts”  
- “Manage accounts” or “Account preferences”  

Then:
- Choose “Accounts with this bank” (not external)  
- Enter any requested info (last 4 digits of account number, card number, or your SSN)  
- Save/confirm, then refresh the Accounts dashboard and check if the checking now appears.

4) If it still doesn’t show: contact support  
When you call/chat/visit a branch, say something like:  
“My main checking account isn’t showing in my online banking. I need it linked to this username.”  

Have ready:
- Your online banking username  
- The checking account number (or at least last 4 digits), and whether it’s joint or individual  
Ask them to:
- Confirm the account is open and active, and  
- Link it to your current online profile (or merge profiles if you have more than one).

Once support confirms it’s linked, sign out, sign back in, and you should be able to see the checking and then its current balance.

If you tell me whether you’re on the mobile app or website, I can give more precise click-by-click steps.</action>

<action type="say">
Here’s what to do in the mobile app (steps may vary slightly by bank, but this is the usual flow):

1) Check if it’s just hidden  
- Open the app and sign in.  
- Go to the main **Accounts** or **Home** tab.  
- Look for a menu like **Settings**, **Profile**, or your initials/photo in a corner.  
- Tap it and look for something like **Accounts**, **Account preferences**, **Display accounts**, or **Manage accounts**.  
- If you see a list with toggles (Show/Hide), make sure your checking account is switched to **Show**.

2) Try “Link/Add existing account”  
If you don’t see the checking there:

- From the main menu (☰ or “More”):  
  - Look for **Link accounts**, **Add account**, **Connect internal account**, or **Show all accounts**.  
- Choose the option that refers to **accounts with this bank** (not “external bank” or “other institution”).  
- Follow prompts to identify the account (they may ask for:  
  - Last 4 digits of the checking account number or debit card  
  - Last 4 of SSN/TIN  
  - Date of birth / ZIP code)  
- Complete and confirm. Then go back to **Accounts** and pull down to refresh.

3) If there’s no way to add/link it in the app  
At this point, you’ll need support to manually link it:

In the app:
- Go to **Support**, **Help**, **Contact us**, or **Message center** (usually in the main menu or profile area).  
- Choose **Chat** or **Call**.

Tell them (you can copy/paste this text if the app allows messages):

> “My main checking account is open and active, but it’s not showing in my mobile app under this login. Can you please link that checking account to this online profile so I can see the balance?”

Have ready:
- Your username (for this mobile profile)  
- The checking account number or last 4 digits  
- Whether it’s individual or joint, and co‑owner’s name if applicable.

They can usually link it while you’re on the call/chat. After they confirm, **log out**, close the app, reopen it, and sign in again; you should then see the checking with its current balance.

If you tell me your bank’s name (or share screenshots with menus blurred except labels), I can adapt these steps to the exact buttons you’ll see. </action>
